contenders.handicapper_notes: Placo boasts elite current staying form on rain-affected ground, coming off a close second in BM78 company on heavy turf at Morphettville Parks following a dominant BM74 victory over 1800m at Murray Bridge. He is effectively unbeaten on heavy/soft surfaces (4 wins from 5 attempts on wet turf). Although rising in weight to 125lbs and stretching out to 2000m, his turn of foot in soft conditions makes him the prime threat to the top selection.

Possesses outstanding heavy track credentials (12: 5-1-0) and drops to a very light 119lbs handicap weight. Won two starts back over 1900m in BM78 grade on soft going at Morphettville Parks. Forgive his recent unplaced run in Melbourne metropolitan grade when caught wide. Drawn barrier 1, he should get an economical rail run and rebound strongly on his home track.
